svg.title: Invitation: context before the booking request
svg.desc: Only the vertical order of three intact content units changes. Evening details and date/arrangements precede the booking request. All words, units, type styles, left anchors, photographs/crops, phone, colors, lighting and footer remain identical. Fictional static invitation.
